solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fine spinach dish? Unfortunately — not!

parts.note: F is the standard abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads

indicators.note: something gone unfortunately has gone wrong, so the letters before it are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A diner hoping for an elegant spinach dish is disappointed to find it isn't one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unfortunately' shuffles F plus SPINACHDISH. The whole clue also defines: the takeaway is a dish, but not a fine spinach one.
explanation.definitionFit: The battered cod and fried potatoes of a British chippy are a dish, but hardly a refined vegetable one.

clue.text: Cooler? Greek sounding enthusiastic

parts.note: a fan is something that cools you

indicators.note: sounding means the word that follows is to be taken by how it is spoken

parts.note: Attic means from Attica, the region round Athens

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a cooling device might sound keen in Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone fanatic is wildly zealous, an extreme form of keenness.

clue.text: Two books: choose the slow burner for the title character

parts.note: 1 and 2 Samuel are two books of the Old Testament
to pick is to choose
a candle's wick burns slowly

explanation.surface: A reader chooses between two books and a candle while picking out a title character.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pickwick Papers is Dickens's novel named after its hero.
explanation.definitionFit: Dickens's The Pickwick Papers takes its title from its central figure, Mr Pickwick.

clue.text: Landed, welcoming Society of the best sort

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in a guest, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: alit is an old past tense of alight, to land

explanation.surface: Landed gentry welcoming high society of the very best kind.
explanation.definitionFit: The A-list is the top tier of celebrities, so it describes the very finest category.

clue.text: Liqueur summary provided

parts.note: a digest is a condensed summary
if means provided that

explanation.surface: A precis of a drink, provided you want one.
explanation.definitionFit: An after-dinner liqueur taken to aid digestion is called by this French name.

clue.text: Hard wood, protection for nut once

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
elm is a timber

explanation.surface: Hard wood used long ago to protect nuts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nut' is slang for the head; 'once' marks the word as archaic.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for a helmet, the armour worn on the head, which slang calls the nut.

clue.text: Exactitude of pair having executed verdict

indicators.note: executed means beheaded, so the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a decision is a verdict

explanation.surface: Two people precisely carry out a judge's verdict.
explanation.definitionFit: Precision and exactitude are synonyms for accuracy.

clue.text: Back untrained gentle, brave men to have succeeded in conflict

indicators.note: back means the word for untrained is read from right to left

parts.note: raw means untrained or inexperienced
soft means gentle

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation for succeeded sits inside the brave men

parts.note: heroes are brave men
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: Raw but gentle and brave men have triumphed in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to have' is a link; 'in' places the genealogical S for succeeded within the brave men, making HEROSES.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the fifteenth-century civil war between the houses of York and Lancaster.

clue.text: Spring roll initially put in for sale

indicators.note: put in means the letter is inserted inside the other piece

parts.note: venal means open to bribery, for sale

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of roll

explanation.surface: A spring roll first put on sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spring roll' is a misleading phrase: 'Spring' is the definition alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal means relating to the season of spring, as in the vernal equinox.

clue.text: They may surround the head doctor introduced to new team

indicators.note: introduced to means the doctor is placed inside the other letters

parts.note: a team such as a cricket or football side has eleven players, II in Roman numerals
MB is a medical degree, so a doctor

explanation.surface: The head doctor is introduced to a new team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'team' is eleven, written as Roman II.
explanation.definitionFit: Haloes are drawn around saints' heads; nimbus is the term and this is its plural.

clue.text: Best time is past to crack joke: start of evening

indicators.note: to crack means to break open, so one piece goes inside the joke

parts.note: a gag is a joke
olden means of past times

indicators.note: start of means only the first letter of evening

explanation.surface: A comedian laments that the best era for cracking jokes is past, as the evening begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A golden age is a period of peak achievement, a society's finest era.

clue.text: Free entertainment is announced in formal document

indicators.note: announced means spoken out, so the words are taken by sound

parts.note: a treat is free entertainment, given by someone else; then 'is' as written

explanation.surface: Free entertainment is declared in an official paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A treatise is a formal written study of a subject.

clue.text: Happens to find shot youngster

parts.note: a hit is a shot that strikes
a son is a youngster

explanation.surface: Someone comes across a youngster who has been shot.
explanation.definitionFit: To hit on something is to discover it by chance.

clue.text: Better run away from hedgehog, monkey!

parts.note: to cap is to better or outdo

indicators.note: away from means the run is taken out of the hedgehog

parts.note: urchin is an old word for hedgehog
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A warning to a monkey to flee from a hedgehog.
explanation.definitionFit: The capuchin is a South American monkey named for its hood-like cap of hair.

clue.text: Porter's egocentric rambling wasting time

indicators.note: rambling means wandering about, so the remaining letters are rearranged
wasting means losing, so the letter for time is dropped

explanation.surface: A hotel porter who rambles self-centredly and wastes time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasting' drops T from EGOCENTRIC; 'rambling' rearranges EGOCENRIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A concierge is a doorkeeper or hotel porter who looks after guests.

clue.text: All one can hold in one hand, but not second: that's irregular

indicators.note: but not means leave the abbreviation for second out

parts.words: All one can hold in one hand
parts.note: a fistful is as much as a hand can grasp

explanation.surface: Holding a handful but not a second one is uneven.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitful means occurring in bursts, without steady regularity.

clue.text: Flowering shrub providing garland for religious leader's hotel

indicators.note: providing means supplying the garland as a stand-in
for means in place of, so the garland takes the hotel's place

parts.note: the Buddha is the founder of Buddhism
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers

explanation.surface: A flowering shrub supplies garlands for a religious leader's hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: Buddleia is the butterfly bush, a shrub with long spikes of purple flowers.

clue.text: Prolific source of money around City

indicators.note: around means the money source wraps the city letters

parts.note: a fund is a store of money to draw on
EC is the postcode area of the City of London

explanation.surface: A productive source of finance in the City.
explanation.definitionFit: Fecund means fertile, highly productive.

clue.text: Wicked and wealthy, not husband material

parts.note: wicked is slang for excellent, as is fab

indicators.note: not means the husband's letter is left out

parts.note: rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: A wicked, wealthy woman who is not marriage material.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is cloth, the material from which garments are made.

clue.text: Point about phony exercises: the "low jump"?

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: the nub is the central point

indicators.note: exercises means works over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trainer's point about phony exercises such as the low jump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns NUB to BUN; 'exercises' rearranges PHONY to NYHOP.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbit-like crouched hop, or a cycling trick lifting both wheels, is a small leap.

clue.text: Chemist has sticker across uniform

indicators.note: across means the sticker spans the uniform letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a paster is a slip of gummed paper, a sticker
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A pharmacist sticks a label across his uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis Pasteur was the French chemist who developed pasteurisation.

clue.text: Loudly regret security arresting tricky partners

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: bail is security given for release
East and West are partners at bridge, a game of tricks

explanation.surface: A bail bondsman lamenting the arrest of crooked associates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tricky' refers to bridge, where E and W form a partnership winning tricks.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewail is to lament or mourn openly.

clue.text: Interrupting fuss pots, judge rises

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so the judge's letter goes inside the fuss

parts.note: ado is fuss
urns are pots

explanation.surface: A judge rises, interrupting a row over pots.
explanation.definitionFit: A court rises when it adjourns, ending its session.

clue.text: Made circular gold sleeper

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a bed is something one sleeps on

explanation.surface: A golden sleeper rounded into a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: Orbed means formed into a sphere or circle.

clue.text: Refuse to shorten brisk walk

indicators.note: to shorten means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a march is a brisk walk

explanation.surface: Declining to cut short a brisk walk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' is a noun, the residue: not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Marc is the pulpy residue of grapes or fruit left after pressing.

clue.text: Instinctive to maintain vehicle In ultimate condition

indicators.note: to maintain means to hold, so the instinct word contains the vehicle

parts.note: innate means instinctive
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: An instinct for keeping a car in perfect condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Incarnate means embodied in its fullest form, as in evil incarnate.

clue.text: Tack in prison, badly defective

indicators.note: defective means lacking, so the word for badly is missing

parts.note: the Bastille was the Paris prison stormed in 1789
ill means badly

explanation.surface: Stitching in a prison done badly and defectively.
explanation.definitionFit: To baste is to sew with long loose temporary stitches, which tacking also means.

clue.text: Trader's reminder to fiddle with cash

indicators.note: to fiddle with is to tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trader's note to self to fiddle the books.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchandiser is one who buys and sells goods, a dealer.
